title: Claude Code quality-of-life update: faster sessions, push notifications, MCP concurrency
summary: Claude Code received a quality-of-life update including push notifications when long tasks finish or input is needed, a /res-style feature reportedly up to 67 percent faster on 40+ MB transcripts, a fix for the recurring re-login prompt, lower memory usage on Linux, concurrent MCP server connection on startup, and various paste, scroll and resize improvements.

research.notes: Compilation of changelog items as described in transcript.
